name: Lisa Moseley
bio: Lisa is currently a postgraduate research student and is completing her PhD exploring unmet health and social needs across the life course in the justice-involved population. Lisa is a qualitative researcher who draws on over ten years’ experience working in social care and with justice-involved people. Lisa has also worked as a research assistant at Northumbria University for two years before beginning her PhD in 2024 at Newcastle University.
researchKeywords: Health inequalities, social inequalities, justice involvement
